product_metadata.title: Wabash Valley Farms Sweet and Easy Snack Machine, Stainless Steel - Create Endless Combinations of Sweet Treats
features: MAKE SNACKS FOR THE FAMILY- OR THE WHOLE NEIGHBORHOOD: This durable, stainless steel pan holds six (6) full quarts of delicious popcorn.

CREATE TREATS THAT ARE TRULY CRAVEABLE: In addition to popcorn, you can whip up taste sensations like heartland kettle corn, ooey gooey chewy caramel corn, for the love of chocolate, chocolate peanut clusters, plus much, much more with the free recipe book included.

EFFORTLESS STIRRING: The direct drive crank easily handles the thickest of mixtures, so you can stir caramel, melted chocolate, sugar syrup and more without a struggle. It also helps ensure that every popcorn kernel pops.

DURABLE AND RELIABLE: The pan is constructed from durable stainless steel and has a clad disk applied to the bottom which minimizes hot spots and evens the heat distribution. It’s Hard Coat Anodized lid is extra thick and resistant to scratching, chipping, and peeling.
POUR ON THE FUN: Locking, spring-loaded, hinged lid combined with a wide opening on the pan allows for smooth pouring. Keep all your kernels and other snacks within the bowl instead of on the floor!
A SWEET BONUS: Every Sweet & Easy comes with a free Real Theater All-Inclusive Popping Kit, recipe book and a 25year warranty.
description: Made of durable stainless steel, Wabash Valley Farms Sweet and Easy Snack Machine is everything you need for making delicious popcorn and so much more. With its direct drive crank, you can stir even the thickest mixtures effortlessly inside the Snack Machine. Makes 6 quarts of tasty popcorn and includes a FREE Real Theater popping kit so you’re prepared to make your first batch right away: premeasured popcorn, seasoning and oil. Learn to use your Snack Machine for a wide variety of other foods including chocolate covered nuts, caramel popcorn, cinnamon roasted nuts, and even roast coffee in it! A recipe booklet is included with purchase to get the inspiration flowing.
